company.statement: SuperMega builds Shop and Plant—operating software for Myanmar businesses, with governed AI assistance inside the workflows.
company.headline: Run your shop or plant from one clear system.
company.supporting: Connect daily work, local payments, inventory, production, and approvals—with AI helping inside the workflow.

products.name: Shop
products.headline: One operating system for the counter and the back office.
products.description: Run sales, stock, customers, bookings, purchasing, payments, reports, and daily close without stitching together separate tools.

templates.name: Retail counter
templates.outcome: Fast selling, stock control, customer history, and a reliable close.

templates.name: Restaurant and inventory
templates.outcome: Menu sales, ingredients, purchasing, waste, cash, and shift close.

templates.name: Service and bookings
templates.outcome: Appointments, work status, customer follow-up, parts, and payments.

templates.name: Multi-branch control
templates.outcome: Shared catalogue, branch roles, transfers, exceptions, and owner reporting.

products.name: Plant
products.headline: Give the factory floor one operational memory.
products.description: Connect production plans, machine state, materials, quality, maintenance, issues, and management handoffs in one controlled system.

templates.name: Production control
templates.outcome: Plan, run, confirm, and review output by line, shift, and product.

templates.name: Maintenance and downtime
templates.outcome: Record machine state, stoppages, ownership, repair, and return to service.

templates.name: Quality and traceability
templates.outcome: Capture checks, exceptions, evidence, approval, and lot history.

templates.name: Material receiving
templates.outcome: Control arrivals, inspection, accepted quantity, variance, and stock handoff.
